title.zh: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七: 英宗一
title.raw: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七: 英宗一 Volume 27 Annals 27: Yingzong 1

sentences.zh: 英宗睿聖文孝皇帝，諱碩德八剌，仁宗嫡子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong, posthumous name Ruisheng Wenxiao, taboo name Shidebala, was Renzong's son by the primary consort.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong, posthumous name Ruisheng Wenxiao, taboo name Shidebala, was Renzong's son by the primary consort.

sentences.zh: 母莊懿慈聖皇后，弘吉剌氏，以大德七年二月甲子生。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred of the Hongjira clan; he was born on jiazi day in the second month of the seventh year of Dade.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred of the Hongjira clan; he was born on jiazi day in the second month of the seventh year of Dade.

sentences.zh: 仁宗欲立為太子，帝入謁太后，固辭，曰：「臣幼無能，且有兄在，宜立兄，以臣輔之。

translations.literal: When Renzong wished to install him as crown prince, he entered to attend upon the Empress Dowager and firmly declined, saying: "Your subject is young and without ability, and has an elder brother still living; the elder brother should be installed, with your subject to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong wished to install him as crown prince, he entered to attend upon the Empress Dowager and firmly declined, saying, "Your subject is young and without ability, and has an elder brother still living; the elder brother should be installed, with your subject to assist him.

sentences.zh: 」太后不許。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager did not assent.

sentences.zh: 延祐三年十二月丁亥，立為皇太子，授金寶，開府置官屬。

translations.literal: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of the third year of YanYou he was installed as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure, and a princely household was opened with officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of the third year of YanYou he was installed as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure, and a princely household was opened with officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 監察御史段輔、太子詹事郭貫等，首請近賢人，擇師傅，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: Surveillance censors Duan Fu, supervisor of the heir apparent's household Guo Guan, and others were first to request drawing near worthy men and selecting tutors; he welcomed and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance censors Duan Fu, supervisor of the heir apparent's household Guo Guan, and others were first to request drawing near worthy men and selecting tutors; he welcomed and accepted this.

sentences.zh: 六年十月戊午，受玉冊，詔命百司庶務必先啟太子，然後奏聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuwu day he received jade tablets; an edict commanded that all offices' diverse affairs must first be reported to the crown prince, and only then memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuwu day he received jade tablets; an edict commanded that all offices' diverse affairs must first be reported to the crown prince, and only then memorialized.

sentences.zh: 帝謂中書省臣曰：「至尊委我以天下事，日夜寅畏，惟恐弗堪。

translations.literal: He said to central secretariat officials: "The Supreme One has entrusted me with the affairs of the realm; day and night I stand in reverent awe, fearing only that I may not be equal to it.
translations.idiomatic: He said to central secretariat officials, "The Supreme One has entrusted me with the affairs of the realm; day and night I stand in reverent awe, fearing only that I may not be equal to it.

sentences.zh: 卿等亦當洗心滌慮，恪勤乃職，勿有隳壞，以貽君父憂。」

translations.literal: You too must cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts, diligently perform your duties, and not cause ruin that would bring grief to lord and father."
translations.idiomatic: You too must cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts, diligently perform your duties, and not cause ruin that would bring grief to lord and father."

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊戌，仁宗不豫，帝憂形於色，夜則焚香，泣曰：「至尊以仁慈禦天下，庶績順成，四海清晏。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day Renzong fell ill; grief showed in his countenance; at night he burned incense and wept, saying: "The Supreme One governs the realm with benevolence; all accomplishments follow smoothly, and the four seas are tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day Renzong fell ill; grief showed in his countenance; at night he burned incense and wept, saying, "The Supreme One governs the realm with benevolence; all accomplishments follow smoothly, and the four seas are tranquil.

sentences.zh: 今天降大厲，不如罰殛我身，使至尊永為民主。

translations.literal: Now Heaven sends great calamity — better to punish and strike down my person, so the Supreme One may forever be lord of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now Heaven sends great calamity — better to punish and strike down my person, so the Supreme One may forever be lord of the people.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，仁宗崩，帝哀毀過禮，素服寢於地，日歠一粥。

translations.literal: " On xinchou day Renzong died; his grief exceeded the rites; he wore plain garments and slept upon the ground, taking one bowl of gruel each day.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou day Renzong died; his grief exceeded the rites; he wore plain garments and slept upon the ground, taking one bowl of gruel each day.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太子太師鐵木叠兒以太后命為右丞相。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Tiemudie'er, grand preceptor of the crown prince, was made right chancellor by the Empress Dowager's command.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Tiemudie'er, grand preceptor of the crown prince, was made right chancellor by the Empress Dowager's command.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使分讞內外刑獄。

translations.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases inside and outside the capital separately.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases inside and outside the capital separately.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑通、漷二州蒙古貧民，汰知樞密院事四員。

translations.literal: On wushen day the impoverished Mongols of Tong and Huo prefectures were relieved; four posts of privy council administrator were eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the impoverished Mongols of Tong and Huo prefectures were relieved; 4 posts of privy council administrator were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 禁巫、祝、日者交通宗戚、大官。

translations.literal: Sorcerers, invokers, and day-selectors were forbidden to associate with imperial kin and great officials.
translations.idiomatic: Sorcerers, invokers, and day-selectors were forbidden to associate with imperial kin and great officials.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，罷造永福寺。

translations.literal: Second month, on renzi day construction of Yongfu Temple was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on renzi day construction of Yongfu Temple was halted.

sentences.zh: 賑大同、豐州諸驛饑。

translations.literal: Famine at the relay stations of Datong and Fengzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Famine at the relay stations of Datong and Fengzhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 以江浙行省左丞相黑驢為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor Heilü was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor Heilü was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，修佛事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Buddhist rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Buddhist rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 建御容殿於永福寺。

translations.literal: An Imperial Image Hall was built at Yongfu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: An Imperial Image Hall was built at Yongfu Temple.

sentences.zh: 汰富民竄名宿衛者，給役蒙古諸驛。

translations.literal: Wealthy commoners who had fraudulently registered as imperial guards were eliminated and assigned corvée at the various Mongol relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy commoners who had fraudulently registered as imperial guards were eliminated and assigned corvée at the various Mongol relay stations.

sentences.zh: 己未，命儲糧於宣德、開平、和林諸倉，以備賑貸供億。

translations.literal: On jiwei day grain was ordered stored at the granaries of Xuande, Kaiping, Karakorum, and elsewhere, to provide for relief, loans, and provisioning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day grain was ordered stored at the granaries of Xuande, Kaiping, Karakorum, and elsewhere, to provide for relief, loans, and provisioning.

sentences.zh: 復以都水監隸中書。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways was again placed under the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways was again placed under the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太陰犯軒轅御女。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the moon encroached upon Chariot Driver's Maid.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon encroached upon Chariot Driver's Maid.

sentences.zh: 平章政事赤斤鐵木兒、御史大夫脫歡罷為集賢大學士。

translations.literal: Grand councillors Chijin Temür and censor-in-chief Tuohuan were dismissed and made grand academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillors Chijin Temür and censor-in-chief Tuohuan were dismissed and made grand academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Lingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Lingtai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，鐵木叠兒、阿散請捕逮四川行省平章政事趙世延赴京。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Tiemudie'er and Asan requested that Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan be arrested and brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Tiemudie'er and Asan requested that Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan be arrested and brought to the capital.

sentences.zh: 參議中書省事乞失監坐鬻官，刑部以法當杖，太后命笞之，帝曰：「不可。

translations.literal: Associate deliberator on central secretariat affairs Qisiji was convicted of selling offices; the Ministry of Justice held that by law he deserved the cudgel; the Empress Dowager commanded he be flogged with the lighter bamboo; he said: "That cannot be.
translations.idiomatic: Associate deliberator on central secretariat affairs Qisiji was convicted of selling offices; the Ministry of Justice held that by law he deserved the cudgel; the Empress Dowager commanded he be flogged with the lighter bamboo; he said, "That cannot be.

sentences.zh: 法者天下之公，徇私而輕重之，非示天下以公也。

translations.literal: Law is the public standard of the realm; to favor private feeling and lighten or aggravate punishment is not to show the realm what is public.
translations.idiomatic: Law is the public standard of the realm; to favor private feeling and lighten or aggravate punishment is not to show the realm what is public.

sentences.zh: 」卒正其罪。

translations.literal: " In the end his guilt was corrected according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end his guilt was corrected according to statute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以陜西行省平章政事趙世榮為中書平章政事，江西行省右丞木八剌為中書右丞，參知政事張思明為中書左丞，中書左丞換住罷為嶺北行省右丞。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shirong was made central secretariat grand councillor; Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Mubala was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; associate administrator Zhang Siming was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat left vice chancellor Huanzhu was dismissed and made Liaobei branch secretariat right vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shirong was made central secretariat grand councillor; Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Mubala was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; associate administrator Zhang Siming was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat left vice chancellor Huanzhu was dismissed and made Liaobei branch secretariat right vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯日星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Sun-star.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Sun-star.

sentences.zh: 白雲宗總攝沈明仁為不法坐罪，詔籍江南冒為白雲僧者為民。

translations.literal: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was convicted of unlawful conduct; an edict registered those in Jiangnan who had falsely pretended to be White Cloud monks as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was convicted of unlawful conduct; an edict registered those in Jiangnan who had falsely pretended to be White Cloud monks as commoners.

sentences.zh: 己巳，修鎮雷佛事於京城四門，罷上都乾元寺規運總管府。

translations.literal: On jisi day thunder-quelling Buddhist rites were performed at the four gates of the capital; the Ganyuan Temple transport commissioner general's office at Shangdu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day thunder-quelling Buddhist rites were performed at the four gates of the capital; the Ganyuan Temple transport commissioner general's office at Shangdu was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛未，括民間系官山場、河泊、窯冶、廬舍。

translations.literal: On xinwei day among the people, state-affiliated mountain preserves, river fisheries, kiln smelteries, and lodgings were registered and assessed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day among the people, state-affiliated mountain preserves, river fisheries, kiln smelteries, and lodgings were registered and assessed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，召陜西行臺御史大夫答失鐵木兒赴闕。

translations.literal: On renshen day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Dash Temür was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Dash Temür was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 以遼陽、大同、上都、甘肅官牧羊馬牛駝給朔方民戶，仍給曠地屯種。

translations.literal: Sheep, horses, cattle, and camels pastured by the government in Liaoyang, Datong, Shangdu, and Gansu were granted to households of the northern frontier; vacant land for garrison-farming was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, cattle, and camels pastured by the government in Liaoyang, Datong, Shangdu, and Gansu were granted to households of the northern frontier; vacant land for garrison-farming was also granted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，括勘崇祥院地，其冒以官地獻者追其直，以民地獻者歸其主。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the lands of the Chongxiang Court were registered and assessed; where official land had been falsely presented as gift, its value was recovered; where commoners' land had been presented, it was returned to its owners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the lands of the Chongxiang Court were registered and assessed; where official land had been falsely presented as gift, its value was recovered; where commoners' land had been presented, it was returned to its owners.

sentences.zh: 決開平重囚。

translations.literal: Heavy criminal cases at Kaiping were decided.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy criminal cases at Kaiping were decided.

sentences.zh: 丙子，定京城環衛更番法，準五衛漢軍歲例。

translations.literal: On bingzi day rotation regulations for the capital's palace guard were fixed, according to the annual precedent of the Five Guards' Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day rotation regulations for the capital's palace guard were fixed, according to the annual precedent of the Five Guards' Han armies.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，奪前中書平章政事李孟所受秦國公制命，仍仆其先墓碑。

translations.literal: On dingchou day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's received patent as Duke of Qin State was stripped, and his ancestors' tomb stele was still overturned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's received patent as Duke of Qin State was stripped, and his ancestors' tomb stele was still overturned.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，中書平章政事兀伯都剌罷為甘肅行省平章政事，阿禮海牙罷為湖廣行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On wuyin day central secretariat grand councillor Wubadula was dismissed and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor; Alimuhaiya was dismissed and made Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day central secretariat grand councillor Wubadula was dismissed and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor; Alimuhaiya was dismissed and made Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 鐵木叠兒以前御史中丞楊朵兒只、中書平章政事蕭拜住違太后旨，矯命殺之，並籍其家。

translations.literal: Tiemudie'er, claiming that former investigating censor-in-chief Yang Duo'erzhi and central secretariat grand councillor Xiao Baizhu had defied the Empress Dowager's command, forged orders and killed them, and confiscated their households.
translations.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er, claiming that former investigating censor-in-chief Yang Duo'erzhi and central secretariat grand councillor Xiao Baizhu had defied the Empress Dowager's command, forged orders and killed them, and confiscated their households.

sentences.zh: 徽政院使失列門，以太后命請更朝官，帝曰：「此豈除官時耶？

translations.literal: Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen, by the Empress Dowager's command, requested replacing court officials; he said: "Is this really the time for appointing and removing officials?
translations.idiomatic: Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen, by the Empress Dowager's command, requested replacing court officials; he said, "Is this really the time for appointing and removing officials?

sentences.zh: 且先帝舊臣，豈宜輕動。

translations.literal: Moreover, they are former ministers of the late emperor — how can they be lightly displaced?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, they are former ministers of the late emperor — how can they be lightly displaced?

sentences.zh: 俟予即位，議於宗親、元老，賢者任之，邪者黜之可也。

translations.literal: Wait until I take the throne; then let it be deliberated among imperial kin and senior ministers — the worthy may be appointed, the wicked may be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until I take the throne; then let it be deliberated among imperial kin and senior ministers — the worthy may be appointed, the wicked may be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」司農卿完者不花言：「先帝以土田頒賜諸臣者，宜悉歸之官。

translations.literal: " Minister of Agriculture Wanbuhehua said: "The land and fields that the late emperor bestowed upon various ministers should all be returned to the government.
translations.idiomatic: " Minister of Agriculture Wanbuhehua said, "The land and fields that the late emperor bestowed upon various ministers should all be returned to the government.

sentences.zh: 」帝問曰：「所賜為誰？

translations.literal: " He asked: "To whom were they granted?
translations.idiomatic: " He asked, "To whom were they granted?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「左丞相阿散所得為多。

translations.literal: " The reply was: "Left chancellor Asan received the most.
translations.idiomatic: " The reply was, "Left chancellor Asan received the most.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「予常諭卿等，當以公心輔弼。

translations.literal: " He said: "I have often instructed you to assist with a public heart.
translations.idiomatic: " He said, "I have often instructed you to assist with a public heart.

sentences.zh: 卿於先朝嘗請海泊之稅，以阿散奏而止。

translations.literal: You once requested the sea-lake tax in the former reign, and it was halted because of Asan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: You once requested the sea-lake tax in the former reign, and it was halted because of Asan's memorial.

sentences.zh: 今卿所言，乃復私憾耳，非公議也，豈輔弼之道耶？

translations.literal: What you now say is again private resentment — not public deliberation; how is this the way of assisting governance?
translations.idiomatic: What you now say is again private resentment — not public deliberation; how is this the way of assisting governance?

sentences.zh: 」遂出完者不花為湖南宣慰使。

translations.literal: " Wanbuhehua was thereupon transferred out as Hunan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: " Wanbuhehua was thereupon transferred out as Hunan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奪僧輦真吃剌思等所受司徒、國公制，仍銷其印。

translations.literal: The received patents as minister of works and state duke of monks including Nianzhen Chilasi were stripped, and their seals cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: The received patents as minister of works and state duke of monks including Nianzhen Chilasi were stripped, and their seals cancelled.

sentences.zh: 洪惟太祖皇帝膺期撫運，肇開帝業；

translations.literal: Grande indeed was Our Taizu Emperor, who received the mandate in season and steadied the era, first opening the imperial enterprise;
translations.idiomatic: Grande indeed was Our Taizu Emperor, who received the mandate in season and steadied the era, first opening the imperial enterprise;

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝神機睿略，統一四海。

translations.literal: Shizu Emperor's divine stratagem and keen designs unified the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu Emperor's divine stratagem and keen designs unified the four seas.

sentences.zh: 以聖繼聖，迨我先皇帝，至仁厚德，涵濡群生，君臨萬國，十年於茲。

translations.literal: Saint succeeding saint, down to Our late emperor — utmost benevolence and deep virtue nourished all living beings and ruled the myriad states; ten years are now complete.
translations.idiomatic: Saint succeeding saint, down to Our late emperor — utmost benevolence and deep virtue nourished all living beings and ruled the myriad states; 10 years are now complete.

sentences.zh: 以社稷之遠圖，定天下之大本，協謀宗親，授予冊寶。

translations.literal: For the distant design of the altars of state, the great foundation of the realm was settled; in concert with deliberation among imperial kin, tablets and treasure were conferred.
translations.idiomatic: For the distant design of the altars of state, the great foundation of the realm was settled; in concert with deliberation among imperial kin, tablets and treasure were conferred.

sentences.zh: 方春宮之與政，遽昭考之賓天。

translations.literal: Just as the eastern palace joined in governance, suddenly Our honored father ascended as guest of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the eastern palace joined in governance, suddenly Our honored father ascended as guest of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 諸王貴戚，元勛碩輔，咸謂朕宜體先帝付托之重，皇太后擁護之慈，既深系於人心，詎可虛於神器，合辭勸進，誠意交孚。

translations.literal: Princes, noble kin, founding ministers, and great aides all said that We ought to embody the weight of the late emperor's entrustment and the Empress Dowager's protective kindness — deeply bound in the hearts of the people, how could the sacred regalia stand empty? Joint memorials urged Our advance, and sincerity met in mutual trust.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, noble kin, founding ministers, and great aides all said that We ought to embody the weight of the late emperor's entrustment and the Empress Dowager's protective kindness — deeply bound in the hearts of the people, how could the sacred regalia stand empty? Joint memorials urged Our advance, and sincerity met in mutual trust.

sentences.zh: 乃於三月十一日，即皇帝位於大明殿。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day of the third month he ascended the imperial throne at Great Brightness Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the third month he ascended the imperial throne at Great Brightness Hall.

sentences.zh: 可赦天下。

translations.literal: An amnesty was proclaimed to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed to the realm.

sentences.zh: 尊太后為太皇太后。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 是夜，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: That night the moon transgressed Mingtang.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed Mingtang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太皇太后受百官朝賀於興聖宮。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Grand Empress Dowager received the court congratulations of all officials at Xingsheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Grand Empress Dowager received the court congratulations of all officials at Xingsheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 鐵木叠兒進開府儀同三司、上柱國、太師。

translations.literal: Tiemudie'er was promoted to commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, and grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er was promoted to commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, and grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 禁宗戚權貴避徭役及作奸犯科。

translations.literal: Imperial kin and powerful families were forbidden from evading corvée and committing crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kin and powerful families were forbidden from evading corvée and committing crimes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，有告嶺北行省平章政事阿散、中書平章政事黑驢及御史大夫脫忒哈、徽政使失列門等與故要束謀妻亦列失八謀廢立，拜住請鞫狀，帝曰：「彼若借太皇太后為詞，奈何？

translations.literal: On wuxu day someone reported that Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Asan, central secretariat grand councillor Heilü, censor-in-chief Tetuha, and Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen and others, together with the late Yaosumou's wife Yilieshiba, plotted to depose and install; Baizhu requested to investigate the case; the Emperor said: "If they invoke the Grand Empress Dowager as pretext, what then?
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day someone reported that Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Asan, central secretariat grand councillor Heilü, censor-in-chief Tetuha, and Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen and others, together with the late Yaosumou's wife Yilieshiba, plotted to depose and install; Baizhu requested to investigate the case; the Emperor said, "If they invoke the Grand Empress Dowager as pretext, what then?

sentences.zh: 」命悉誅之，籍其家。

translations.literal: " An order commanded all be executed; their households were registered.
translations.idiomatic: " An order commanded all be executed; their households were registered.

sentences.zh: 追封隴西公汪世顯為隴右王。

translations.literal: Duke Wang Shixian of Longxi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Wang Shixian of Longxi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Longyou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以知樞密院事鐵木兒脫為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day privy council administrator Temür Tuo was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day privy council administrator Temür Tuo was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，監察御史請罷僧、道、工、伶濫爵及建寺、豢獸之費。

translations.literal: On renyin day surveillance censors requested abolishing excessive titles for monks, Daoists, artisans, and actors, and the expenses of building temples and keeping beasts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day surveillance censors requested abolishing excessive titles for monks, Daoists, artisans, and actors, and the expenses of building temples and keeping beasts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以誅阿散、黑驢、賀伯顏等詔天下。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict to the realm proclaimed the execution of Asan, Heilü, He Boiyan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict to the realm proclaimed the execution of Asan, Heilü, He Boiyan, and others.

sentences.zh: 敕百司日勤政務，怠者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict directed all offices to be diligent in government affairs daily; the negligent were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed all offices to be diligent in government affairs daily; the negligent were to be punished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，御史劉恒請興義倉及奪僧、道官。

translations.literal: On bingwu day censor Liu Heng requested establishing charity granaries and stripping monks and Daoists of official rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day censor Liu Heng requested establishing charity granaries and stripping monks and Daoists of official rank.

sentences.zh: 敕捕亦列失八子江浙行省平章政事買驢，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: An edict commanded the capture of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Mailu, son of Yilieshiba; his household was still registered.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded the capture of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Mailu, son of Yilieshiba; his household was still registered.

sentences.zh: 丁未，封王禪為雲南王，往鎮其地。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Wang Chan was enfeoffed Prince of Yunnan and dispatched to guard that territory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Wang Chan was enfeoffed Prince of Yunnan and dispatched to guard that territory.

sentences.zh: 饒州番陽縣進嘉禾，一莖六穗。

translations.literal: Poyang County of Raozhou presented auspicious grain — one stalk with six ears.
translations.idiomatic: Poyang County of Raozhou presented auspicious grain — one stalk with 6 ears.

sentences.zh: 以賀伯顏、失列門、阿散家貲、田宅賜鐵木叠兒等。

translations.literal: The property, fields, and dwellings of He Boiyan, Shiliemen, and Asan were granted to Tiemudie'er and others.
translations.idiomatic: The property, fields, and dwellings of He Boiyan, Shiliemen, and Asan were granted to Tiemudie'er and others.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，流徽政院使米薛迷於金剛山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiyou day Palace Domestic Service commissioner Miximi was exiled to Diamond Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiyou day Palace Domestic Service commissioner Miximi was exiled to Diamond Mountain.

sentences.zh: 以脫忒哈、失列門故奪人畜產歸其主。

translations.literal: Because of Tetuha's and Shiliemen's past conduct, livestock and property seized from others were returned to their owners.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Tetuha's and Shiliemen's past conduct, livestock and property seized from others were returned to their owners.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，前太子詹事床兀兒伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiayin day former crown prince household intendant Chuangwu'er was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day former crown prince household intendant Chuangwu'er was executed.

sentences.zh: 京師疫，修佛事於萬壽山。

translations.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; Buddhist rites were performed at Wanshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; Buddhist rites were performed at Wanshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，昌王阿失部饑，賜鈔千萬貫賑之。

translations.literal: On yimao day Prince Chang Axi's department suffered famine; ten million strings of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Chang Axi's department suffered famine; 10 million strings of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 賞誅阿散等功，賜拜住以下金銀、鈔有差。

translations.literal: Merit in suppressing Asan and others was rewarded; Baizhu and those below him were granted gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Merit in suppressing Asan and others was rewarded; Baizhu and those below him were granted gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召河南行省平章政事埜仙帖穆兒至京師，收脫忒哈廣平王印。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Yesun Temür was summoned to the capital; the Guangping Prince seal of Tetuha was collected.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Yesun Temür was summoned to the capital; the Guangping Prince seal of Tetuha was collected.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以江西行省左丞相脫脫為御史大夫，宗正紥魯火赤鐵木兒不花知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left chancellor Tuotuo was made censor-in-chief; Director of the Imperial Clan Zhaluhuochi Temür Buqa was made privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left chancellor Tuotuo was made censor-in-chief; director of the Imperial Clan Zhaluhuochi Temür Buqa was made privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷徽政院。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Palace Domestic Service was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Palace Domestic Service was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣東采珠提舉司罷，以有司領其事。

translations.literal: The Guangdong pearl-collection office was abolished; regular officials were placed in charge of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong pearl-collection office was abolished; regular officials were placed in charge of the matter.

sentences.zh: 封知樞密院事塔失鐵木兒為薊國公。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Tash Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Tash Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.

sentences.zh: 己未，定邊地盜孳畜罪犯者，令給各部力役，如不悛，斷罪如內地法。

translations.literal: On jiwei day it was fixed that on the frontier, those guilty of stealing and breeding livestock were to be assigned corvée to the various departments; if they did not reform, punishment was to follow interior law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day it was fixed that on the frontier, those guilty of stealing and breeding livestock were to be assigned corvée to the various departments; if they did not reform, punishment was to follow interior law.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 賜角百二十人鈔各千貫。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty wrestlers were granted one thousand strings of notes each.
translations.idiomatic: 120 wrestlers were granted 1,000 strings of notes each.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔免僧人雜役。

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict exempted monks from miscellaneous corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict exempted monks from miscellaneous corvée.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，敕諸使至京者，大事五日、小事三日遣還。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict directed that envoys arriving at the capital — for major affairs five days, for minor affairs three days — then be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict directed that envoys arriving at the capital — for major affairs 5 days, for minor affairs 3 days — then be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月食既。

translations.literal: That night the lunar eclipse reached totality.
translations.idiomatic: That night the lunar eclipse reached totality.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賑北邊饑民，有妻子者鈔千五百貫，孤獨者七百五十貫。

translations.literal: On yichou day famine-stricken people of the northern frontier were relieved — those with wives and children one thousand five hundred strings of notes, the solitary seven hundred fifty strings.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day famine-stricken people of the northern frontier were relieved — those with wives and children 1,500 strings of notes, the solitary 750 strings.

sentences.zh: 新作太祖幄殿。

translations.literal: A new tent hall of the Great Ancestor was built.
translations.idiomatic: A new tent hall of the Great Ancestor was built.

sentences.zh: 西番盜洛各目降。

translations.literal: Dao Luogemu of the western barbarians surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Luogemu of the western barbarians surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白犯井。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王阿木裏臺宴服、珠帽。

translations.literal: Prince Amulitai was granted banquet robes and a pearl cap.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Amulitai was granted banquet robes and a pearl cap.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑雷家驛戶鈔萬五千貫。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the relay households of Leijia were granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the relay households of Leijia were granted 15,000 strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜北邊諸王伯要臺等十人鈔各二萬五千貫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day ten northern frontier princes including Bo Yaotai were each granted twenty-five thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 10 northern frontier princes including Bo Yaotai were each granted 25,000 strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 邊民賑米三月。

translations.literal: Border people were granted three months' relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Border people were granted 3 months' relief grain.

sentences.zh: 修寧夏欽察魯佛事，給鈔二百一十二萬貫。

translations.literal: Kipchak Buddhist rites at Ningxia were repaired; two million one hundred twenty thousand strings of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Kipchak Buddhist rites at Ningxia were repaired; 2,120,000 strings of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改紅城中都威衛為忠翊侍衛親軍都指揮使司，隸樞密院。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Red City Zhongdu Guard was changed to the Loyal Support Guard Personal Army Commanderate, subordinate to the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Red City Zhongdu Guard was changed to the Loyal Support Guard Personal Army Commanderate, subordinate to the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 罷章慶司、延福司、群牧監、宮正司、遼陽萬戶府，復徽儀司為繕珍司，善政司為都總管府，內宰司、延慶司、甄用監復為正三品。

translations.literal: The Zhangqing Office, Yanfu Office, Herds Directorate, Palace Standards Office, and Liaoyang wanhu office were abolished; the Empress Insignia Office was restored as the Repair Treasures Bureau, the Good Governance Office as the Chief Resident Commissionerate, and the Inner Steward Office, Yanqing Office, and Selection Inspectorate were restored to primary third grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhangqing Office, Yanfu Office, Herds Directorate, Palace Standards Office, and Liaoyang wanhu office were abolished; the Empress Insignia Office was restored as the Repair Treasures Bureau, the Good Governance Office as the Chief Resident Commissionerate, and the Inner Steward Office, Yanqing Office, and Selection Inspectorate were restored to primary third grade.

sentences.zh: 益都蝗，荊門州旱，棣州、高郵、江陵水。

translations.literal: Yidu suffered locusts; Jingmen Prefecture drought; Dizhou, Gaoyou, and Jiangling flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu suffered locusts; Jingmen Prefecture drought; Dizhou, Gaoyou, and Jiangling flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，賜諸王曲魯不花鈔萬五千貫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Prince Quru Buqa was granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Prince Quru Buqa was granted 15,000 strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 命玄教宗師張留孫修醮事於崇真宮。

translations.literal: Zhang Liusun, patriarch of the Mysterious Teaching, was ordered to perform ritual observances at Chongzhen Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liusun, patriarch of the Mysterious Teaching, was ordered to perform ritual observances at Chongzhen Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，立普定路屯田，分烏撒、烏蒙屯田卒二千赴之。

translations.literal: On renwu day a garrison farm at Puding Route was established; two thousand garrison soldiers from Wusa and Wumeng were divided and sent there.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a garrison farm at Puding Route was established; 2,000 garrison soldiers from Wusa and Wumeng were divided and sent there.

sentences.zh: 運和林糧於紥昆倉，以便邊軍，市馬三萬、羊四萬給邊軍貧乏者。

translations.literal: Karakorum grain was transported to the Zhakun granary to supply frontier troops; thirty thousand horses and forty thousand sheep were purchased for impoverished frontier soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum grain was transported to the Zhakun granary to supply frontier troops; 30,000 horses and 40,000 sheep were purchased for impoverished frontier soldiers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，括馬於大同、興和、冀寧三路，以頒衛士。

translations.literal: On guiwei day horses were registered in Datong, Xinghe, and Jining routes to be distributed to the guards.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day horses were registered in Datong, Xinghe, and Jining routes to be distributed to the guards.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕將北幸，調左右翊軍赴北邊浚井。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, because the imperial carriage was about to visit the north, the left and right wing armies were mobilized to dig wells on the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, because the imperial carriage was about to visit the north, the left and right wing armies were mobilized to dig wells on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 以知樞密院事買驢、哈丹並為遼陽行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Mailu and Hadan were both made Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Mailu and Hadan were both made Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜諸王買奴等鈔二十五萬貫。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Prince Mainu and others were granted two hundred fifty thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Prince Mainu and others were granted 250,000 strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 諸王告住等部火，賑糧三月、鈔萬五千貫。

translations.literal: Fire struck the department of Princes Gaozhu and others; three months' relief grain and fifteen thousand strings of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Fire struck the department of Princes Gaozhu and others; 3 months' relief grain and 15,000 strings of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 晉王也孫鐵木兒部饑，賑鈔五千萬貫。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following suffered famine; fifty million ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following suffered famine; 50 million ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷女直萬戶府及狗站脫脫禾孫，散遼陽紅花萬戶府兵。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Jurchen wanhu office and dog-relay tuotuhesun posts were abolished, and the troops of Liaoyang's Honghua wanhu office were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Jurchen wanhu office and dog-relay tuotuhesun posts were abolished, and the troops of Liaoyang's Honghua wanhu office were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 遣扈從諸營還大都，禁踐民禾。

translations.literal: The escort retinue camps were ordered back to Dadu; trampling civilian grain fields was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The escort retinue camps were ordered back to Dadu; trampling civilian grain fields was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 安南內附人陳巖言其國貢使多為覘伺，敕湖廣行省汰遣之。

translations.literal: Chen Yan, a submitted person from Annam, said that many of his state's tribute envoys were engaged in espionage; an edict directed the Huguang branch secretariat to cull and send them away.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yan, a submitted person from Annam, said that many of his state's tribute envoys were engaged in espionage; an edict directed the Huguang branch secretariat to cull and send them away.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜西僧沙加鈔萬五千貫，以甘肅行省平章欽察臺知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the Western monk Shajia was granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor Qincha Tai, privy council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Western monk Shajia was granted 15,000 ingots of notes and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor Qincha Tai, privy council commissioner.

sentences.zh: 回回太醫進藥曰打裏牙，給鈔十五萬貫。

translations.literal: A Muslim imperial physician presented medicine called Darliya; one hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: A Muslim imperial physician presented medicine called Darliya; 150,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以昌平、灤陽十二驛供億繁重，給鈔三十萬貫賑之。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, because the twelve relay stations of Changping and Luanyang were heavily burdened with supplies, three hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because the 12 relay stations of Changping and Luanyang were heavily burdened with supplies, 300,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 中書平章政事乃剌忽罷。

translations.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Nalihu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Nalihu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 降封安王兀都不花為順陽王。

translations.literal: Prince of An Wudubuhua was demoted and enfeoffed Prince of Shunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of An Wudubuhua was demoted and enfeoffed Prince of Shunyang.

sentences.zh: 禁獻珍寶制袞冕。

translations.literal: Presenting precious objects to manufacture imperial robes and caps was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting precious objects to manufacture imperial robes and caps was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Fang.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣言：「塔海萬戶部不剌兀赤與北兵戰，拔軍士三百人以還，棄其子於野，殺所乘馬以啖士卒，請賞之。

translations.literal: Privy council officials said: "In fighting northern troops, Bukeruochi of Ta Hai wanhu's department rescued three hundred soldiers and returned, abandoned his son in the wild, and killed his mount to feed the troops — we request he be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council officials said, "In fighting northern troops, Bukeruochi of Ta Hai wanhu's department rescued 300 soldiers and returned, abandoned his son in the wild, and killed his mount to feed the troops — we request he be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 」賜鈔五千貫。

translations.literal: " Five thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Five thousand ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 斡魯思辰告諸王月兒魯鐵木兒謀變，賞鈔萬五千貫，敕中外希賞自請者勿予。

translations.literal: Wolusi Chen reported that Prince Yue'erlu Temür plotted rebellion; fifteen thousand ingots of notes were granted as reward; an edict directed that throughout the realm those who sought rewards on their own initiative should not receive them.
translations.idiomatic: Wolusi Chen reported that Prince Yue'erlu Temür plotted rebellion; 15,000 ingots of notes were granted as reward; an edict directed that throughout the realm those who sought rewards on their own initiative should not receive them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On jihai day the moon encroached upon Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon encroached upon Mao.

sentences.zh: 賜女巫伯牙臺鈔萬五千貫。

translations.literal: The witch Boyatai was granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: The witch Boyatai was granted 15,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以江南行御史臺中丞廉恂為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Jiangnan branch censorate chief censor Lian Xun was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jiangnan branch censorate chief censor Lian Xun was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜公主紥牙八剌等鈔七萬五千貫。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Princess Zhajibala and others were granted seventy-five thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Princess Zhajibala and others were granted 75,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 晉王也孫鐵木兒遣使以地七千。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Yesun Temür dispatched envoys presenting seven thousand qing of land.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Yesun Temür dispatched envoys presenting 7,000 qing of land.

sentences.zh: 頃歸朝廷，請有司征其租，歲給糧鈔，從之。

translations.literal: to be returned to the court; he requested the relevant office collect its rent, with grain and notes granted annually; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: to be returned to the court; he requested the relevant office collect its rent, with grain and notes granted annually; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 以遼陽金銀鐵冶歸中政院。

translations.literal: Liaoyang's gold, silver, and iron smelters were transferred to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai day capital officials' salary notes were calculated, with three-tenths paid in grain.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Mars transgressed Wall Formation.

translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau drafted and submitted the ritual for seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

translations.idiomatic: Therefore on Bingzi of the eleventh month of YanYou seventh year, arrayed in ceremonial robes and cap, we reverently offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

translations.literal: Now that the great rite has been completed, universal rejoicing throughout the realm is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the great rite has been completed, universal rejoicing throughout the realm is fitting.

translations.literal: As a full year has now passed, we change the reign era to guide Heaven and Earth's supreme harmony and follow the Spring and Autumn Annals' scrupulous beginning — let next year be the first year of Zhizhi.
translations.idiomatic: As a full year has now passed, we change the reign era to guide Heaven and Earth's supreme harmony and follow the Spring and Autumn Annals' scrupulous beginning — let next year be the first year of Zhizhi.

sentences.zh: 減天下租賦二分，包銀五分。

translations.literal: Reduce land rent and taxes throughout the realm by two-tenths, and tax-in-kind silver by five-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce land rent and taxes throughout the realm by two-tenths, and tax-in-kind silver by five-tenths.

sentences.zh: 免大都、上都、興和三路差稅三年。

translations.literal: Remit miscellaneous taxes for three years in the three routes of Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Remit miscellaneous taxes for 3 years in the 3 routes of Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 優復煮鹽、煉鐵等戶二年。

translations.literal: Grant preferential remission for two years to salt-boiling, iron-smelting, and similar households.
translations.idiomatic: Grant preferential remission for 2 years to salt-boiling, iron-smelting, and similar households.

sentences.zh: 開燕南、山東河泊之禁，聽民采取。

translations.literal: Lift prohibitions on lakes and marshes in Yan South and Shandong, allowing the people to gather produce.
translations.idiomatic: Lift prohibitions on lakes and marshes in Yan South and Shandong, allowing the people to gather produce.

sentences.zh: 命官家屬流落邊遠者，有司資給遣之；

translations.literal: Order that officials' family members stranded in distant border regions be provided travel funds by the relevant offices and sent home;
translations.idiomatic: Order that officials' family members stranded in distant border regions be provided travel funds by the relevant offices and sent home;

sentences.zh: 其子女典鬻於人者，聽還其家。

translations.idiomatic: Those whose sons and daughters had been pawned or sold to others were permitted to return to their families.

sentences.zh: 監察御史、廉訪司歲舉可任守令者二人。

translations.literal: Supervising censors and surveillance commissions shall each year recommend two persons fit to serve as prefects or magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors and surveillance commissions shall each year recommend 2 persons fit to serve as prefects or magistrates.

sentences.zh: 七品以上官，有偉畫長策可以濟世安民者，實封上之。

translations.literal: Officials of seventh rank and above who have bold plans and long-reaching policies that can benefit the age and bring peace to the people shall submit them sealed intact.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of seventh rank and above who have bold plans and long-reaching policies that can benefit the age and bring peace to the people shall submit them sealed intact.

sentences.zh: 士有隱居行義，明治體，不求聞達者，有司具狀以聞。

translations.literal: Scholars who live in retirement practicing integrity, understand governmental principles, and seek no renown shall have full particulars reported by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars who live in retirement practicing integrity, understand governmental principles, and seek no renown shall have full particulars reported by the relevant offices.

translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day copper was cast into a Buddhist image and placed in the Jade Virtue Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜壽寧公主鈔七萬五千貫。

translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Princess Shouning was granted 75,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以天壽節，預遣使修醮於龍虎山。

translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, on account of the Heavenly Longevity Festival, envoys were dispatched in advance to perform Daoist rites at Longhu Mountain.

translations.literal: On yimao day, leading all officials, the jade book and jade seal were presented, adding to the Grand Empress Dowager the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, leading all officials, the jade book and jade seal were presented, adding to the Grand Empress Dowager the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士忽都魯都兒迷失譯進宋儒真德秀《大學衍義》，帝曰：「修身治國，無逾此書。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Qotlughdurumishi presented in translation Song Confucian Zhen Dexiu's Extension of the Great Learning; the Emperor said: "For self-cultivation and governing the state, nothing surpasses this book.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Qotlughdurumishi presented in translation Song Confucian Zhen Dexiu's Extension of the Great Learning; the Emperor said, "For self-cultivation and governing the state, nothing surpasses this book.

translations.idiomatic: 50,000 ingots of notes were granted.

translations.literal: Henan suffered famine; the Emperor asked the reason, and the assembled ministers could not answer; the Emperor said: "Truly it is because our Way of governance has not yet reached full harmony, you likewise have not fully devoted yourselves to your duties, and appointments have missed the right men, causing yin and yang to fall out of harmony and disasters to arrive one after another.

sentences.zh: 自今各務勤恪，以應天心，毋使吾民重困。

translations.idiomatic: From now on each must strive to be diligent and reverent to respond to Heaven's intent, and must not let our people suffer yet heavier distress.

translations.idiomatic: The moon masked the Pleiades.

translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because the ceremony of adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received court congratulations.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict was proclaimed to the court and the realm.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Well.

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Ghost.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the rear hall of Extended Spring Pavilion was constructed.

translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Western monk Rinchen Qarshi was summoned to the capital; an edict directed the prefectures and counties he passed through to receive him with solemn ceremony.

translations.literal: On yichou day a comet was observed for forty day-and-night cycles at the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day a comet was observed for 40 day-and-night cycles at the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以典瑞院使闊徹伯知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Kuochebo, commissioner of the Registry of Auspicious Objects, was made privy council director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Kuochebo, commissioner of the Registry of Auspicious Objects, was made privy council director.

sentences.zh: 修秘密佛事於延春閣。

translations.literal: Secret Buddhist rites were performed at Extended Spring Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Secret Buddhist rites were performed at Extended Spring Pavilion.

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Those who speak on affairs of state may come directly before Us; as for common people who casually lodge lawsuits, that is to be forbidden.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because the ceremony adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, announcement was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己巳，敕罷明年二月八日迎佛。

translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict abolished the Buddha-welcoming rite of the eighth day of the second month next year.

translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Mubalagha was dismissed and made Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor; central secretariat associate administrator Jirihang was made right vice chancellor; Jiangnan and western Zhejiang surveillance commissioner Xue Chujing was made central secretariat associate administrator.

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to inspect the military supplies storehouse of Fengyuan Route.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to inspect the military supplies storehouse of Fengyuan Route.

translations.literal: On xinwei day Baizhu submitted diagrams of the imperial escort insignia; the Emperor held that the Tang system used twelve thousand three hundred men and wasted resources, and therefore fixed the grand escort at three thousand two hundred men and the statutory escort at two thousand five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Baizhu submitted diagrams of the imperial escort insignia; the Emperor held that the Tang system used 12,300 men and wasted resources, and therefore fixed the grand escort at 3,200 men and the statutory escort at 2,500 men.

translations.literal: The Yao of Shangsi Prefecture joined with Annam to raid Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao of Shangsi Prefecture joined with Annam to raid Zhong Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor heard that He Bayan's mother was old and took pity; the seized Jingzhao fields and water mills were returned to his family.

translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Bayanchar and Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Baisadu were both dismissed from office on conviction of corruption.

translations.idiomatic: That year, 7,630 cases of lighter and heavier criminal judgment were decided.

translations.idiomatic: The Hun River overflowed, destroying people's fields and dwellings.

translations.idiomatic: In Chengji County, Qin Prefecture, violent rain caused mountains to collapse, rotten and ruined tombs to rise up, and livestock and property to be buried.

translations.idiomatic: In Yanjin County, Bianliang, a great wind darkened the day; many mulberry trees were damaged.

translations.idiomatic: In Datong there was hail; the largest were like chicken eggs.

translations.idiomatic: Garrison-farm fields of the various guards were harmed by frost; in Yijin County black frost fell with rain.

translations.idiomatic: Zhizhi first year, spring, first month, on dingchou day Buddhist rites were performed at Wende Hall.

translations.idiomatic: On renwu day 1 post each of associate commissioner and transport judge was added to the Huozhou Capital Grain Transport Commission.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day King Wang Jang of Goryeo was summoned to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，帝服袞冕，享太廟，以左丞相拜住亞獻，知樞密院事闊徹伯終獻。

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor, clad in ceremonial robes and cap, offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; left chancellor Baizhu served as secondary presenter and privy council director Kuochebo as final presenter.

translations.idiomatic: An edict to the assembled ministers stated, "In a year there are only four sacrifices; to have others perform them in Our stead cannot produce the sincerity of being present in person — truly We cannot be at ease with this.

translations.idiomatic: Each year We shall personally sacrifice, for the remainder of Our life.

translations.idiomatic: Court ministers spoke saying that when the sacrificial rites were completed the realm should be amnestied; the Emperor instructed them, "Favor may be regularly bestowed, but amnesties must not be frequently issued.

translations.literal: If murderers obtain release, what wrong have the dead committed?"
translations.idiomatic: If murderers obtain release, what wrong have the dead committed?"

translations.idiomatic: An order directed the central secretariat to present matters of convenience and carry them out.

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Mercury transgressed Outer Screen.

translations.idiomatic: Mercury, Venus, Mars, and Saturn — 4 planets — gathered at Kui.

translations.idiomatic: On wushen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.

translations.idiomatic: Central Capital Weiguard was renamed Loyal Support Personal Guard Army Command.

translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an imperial spirit hall for Renzong was built at Pujing Temple.

translations.idiomatic: At night on renzi day Venus, Mars, and Saturn — 3 stars — gathered at Kui.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor hunted at Willow Grove; an edict directed reconstruction of the traveling palace.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus transgressed Mars.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall; assembled officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Continuing Heaven, Embodying the Way, Reverent in Culture, Benevolent and Martial, Greatly Manifest and Filial.

sentences.zh: 是夜，辰星犯房。

translations.literal: That night Mercury transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: That night Mercury transgressed Room.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以受尊號詔天下，拜住請釋囚，不允。

translations.literal: On jimao day, because the honorific title had been received, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; Baizhu requested releasing prisoners — it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, because the honorific title had been received, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; Baizhu requested releasing prisoners — it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，益壽安山寺役卒三千人。

translations.literal: On gengchen day three thousand corvée soldiers were added for Shou'an Mountain Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day 3,000 corvée soldiers were added for Shou'an Mountain Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命御史大夫鐵失領左、右阿速衛。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Censor-in-chief Teshi was ordered to command the left and right Asud guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day censor-in-chief Teshi was ordered to command the left and right Asud guards.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the moon transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以教官待選者借註廣海巡檢。

translations.literal: On dinghai day instructor officials awaiting selection were temporarily registered as Guanghai patrol inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day instructor officials awaiting selection were temporarily registered as Guanghai patrol inspectors.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太陰犯酒旗，又犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jichou day the moon transgressed Wine Banner, and also transgressed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon transgressed Wine Banner, and also transgressed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，拜住等言：「受尊號，宜謝太廟，行一獻禮。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Baizhu and others said, "Having received the honorific title, one ought to give thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing one libation offering.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Baizhu and others said, "Having received the honorific title, one ought to give thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing one libation offering.

sentences.zh: 世祖亦嘗議行，武宗則躬行謝禮。

translations.literal: Shizu also once discussed carrying it out; Wuzong personally performed the thanksgiving rite.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu also once discussed carrying it out; Wuzong personally performed the thanksgiving rite.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「朕當親謝。

translations.literal: " An edict stated, "We shall personally give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "We shall personally give thanks.

sentences.zh: 」命太史卜日，樞密選兵肄鹵簿。

translations.literal: " The Imperial Astronomer was ordered to divine the date; the privy council selected troops to drill the guard of honor.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Astronomer was ordered to divine the date; the privy council selected troops to drill the guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Mingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Mingtang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以營田提舉司征酒稅擾民，命有司兼榷之。

translations.literal: On guisi day because the garrison-farm intendant office's collection of liquor tax disturbed the people, the relevant offices were ordered to take over and monopolize it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day because the garrison-farm intendant office's collection of liquor tax disturbed the people, the relevant offices were ordered to take over and monopolize it.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以遼陽行省管內山場隸中政院。

translations.literal: On jiawu day mountain preserves within Liaoyang branch secretariat jurisdiction were placed under the Central Bureau for Imperial Household Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day mountain preserves within Liaoyang branch secretariat jurisdiction were placed under the Central Bureau for Imperial Household Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，敕立故丞相安童碑於保定新城。

translations.literal: On bingshen day an edict directed that a stele for the late grand councillor Antong be erected at Baoding New City.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict directed that a stele for the late grand councillor Antong be erected at Baoding New City.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鞏昌成州饑，發義倉賑之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Gongchang's Chengzhou suffered famine; benevolent granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Gongchang's Chengzhou suffered famine; benevolent granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯西咸。

translations.literal: On jihai day Venus transgressed Western Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus transgressed Western Kui.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，給蒙古子女冬衣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengzi day winter clothing was granted to Mongol children.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengzi day winter clothing was granted to Mongol children.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，立亦啟烈氏為皇后，遣攝太尉、中書右丞相鐵木叠兒持節授玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Yiqi Lie was installed as empress; acting Grand Mentor and right central secretariat chancellor Temür Temür was dispatched with credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yiqi Lie was installed as empress; acting grand mentor and right central secretariat chancellor Temür Temür was dispatched with credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以立後詔天下。

translations.literal: On guimao day, because the empress had been installed, an edict was proclaimed to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the empress had been installed, an edict was proclaimed to the realm.

sentences.zh: 慶遠路饑，真定路疫，並賑之。

translations.literal: Qingyuan Route suffered famine and Zhending Route suffered plague; both were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan Route suffered famine and Zhending Route suffered plague; both were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，熒惑犯亢。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Mars transgressed Neck.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Mars transgressed Neck.

sentences.zh: 戊申，躬謝太廟。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Emperor personally gave thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor personally gave thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 作太廟正殿。

translations.literal: The main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: The main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was constructed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，疏玉泉河。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Yuquan River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Yuquan River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸西僧灌項寺。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage visited the Western monk's Abhiseka Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage visited the Western monk's Abhiseka Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，封唆南藏卜為白蘭王，賜金印。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Sonam Zangbu was enfeoffed as Prince of Bailan and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Sonam Zangbu was enfeoffed as Prince of Bailan and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 真定、保定、大名、順德等路水，民饑，禁釀酒。

translations.literal: Zhending, Baoding, Daming, Shunde, and other routes suffered flooding; the people suffered famine; brewing liquor was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Zhending, Baoding, Daming, Shunde, and other routes suffered flooding; the people suffered famine; brewing liquor was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 以金虎符頒各行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Gold tiger tallys were issued to branch secretariat grand councillors of each province.
translations.idiomatic: Gold tiger tallys were issued to branch secretariat grand councillors of each province.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mars entered Di.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置田糧提舉司，掌薊、景二州田賦，以給衛士貧乏者，秩從五品。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Field Revenue Intendant Office was established, administering land tax of Ji and Jing prefectures to supply impoverished guard soldiers, rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the field revenue intendant office was established, administering land tax of Ji and Jing prefectures to supply impoverished guard soldiers, rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 命帝師公哥羅古羅思監藏班藏卜詣西番受具足戒，賜金千三百五十兩、銀四千五十兩、幣帛萬匹、鈔五十萬貫。

translations.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Gagla Ras Gyinchen Bzangpo was ordered to proceed to the western regions to receive full ordination; he was granted one thousand three hundred fifty liang of gold, four thousand fifty liang of silver, ten thousand bolts of silks and cloths, and five hundred thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor Gagla Ras Gyinchen Bzangpo was ordered to proceed to the western regions to receive full ordination; he was granted 1,350 liang of gold, 4,050 liang of silver, 10,000 bolts of silks and cloths, and 500,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 以諸王怯伯使者數入朝，發兵守北口及盧溝橋。

translations.literal: Because Prince Kebek's envoys repeatedly came to court, troops were deployed to guard Beikou and Lugou Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Because Prince Kebek's envoys repeatedly came to court, troops were deployed to guard Beikou and Lugou Bridge.

sentences.zh: 河間路饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Hejian Route suffered famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian Route suffered famine; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 復以馬家奴為司徒。

translations.literal: Ma Jianu was again made Situ.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jianu was again made Situ.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，置中瑞司。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Central Auspice Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Central Auspice Office was established.

sentences.zh: 冶銅五十萬斤作壽安山寺佛像。

translations.literal: Five hundred thousand jin of copper was smelted to make Buddha images for Shou'an Mountain Temple.
translations.idiomatic: 500,000 jin of copper was smelted to make Buddha images for Shou'an Mountain Temple.

sentences.zh: 寧海州蝗，歸德、遼陽、通州等處水。

translations.literal: Ninghai Prefecture suffered locusts; Guide, Liaoyang, Tongzhou, and other places suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghai Prefecture suffered locusts; Guide, Liaoyang, Tongzhou, and other places suffered flooding.
